name: io.github.letheliu/geociteops
title: GeoCiteOps
description: GEO health checks, agent readiness audits, citation checks, share of voice, content optimization, JSON-LD, llms.txt, and knowledge-graph extraction. Agent readiness, llms.txt, and JSON-LD also run in-process with no API key. Citation and health checks call a GeoCiteOps API you host.

environmentVariables.name: GEOCITEOPS_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of a GeoCiteOps API. Default http://localhost:4000.

environmentVariables.name: GEOCITEOPS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Workspace API key (x-api-key). Omit it to use the in-process readiness, llms.txt, and JSON-LD tools only.

environmentVariables.name: GEOCITEOPS_WORKSPACE_ID
environmentVariables.description: Sent as x-workspace-id. The API ignores it on the API-key channel.

environmentVariables.name: GEOCITEOPS_PREFER_LOCAL
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 or true to force in-process readiness, llms.txt, and JSON-LD even when an API key is set.
